blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Members of the Aquino family and other Filipinos visited the Aquino family mausoleum at the Manila Memorial Park in Parañaque City on Monday, All Souls’ Day. Civil society leader Kiko Aquino Dee, with his parents, Viel Aquino Dee and Richard Dee, lit yellow candles and offered prayers at the mausoleum to remember the late former senator Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr., and former presidents Corazon “Cory” Aquino and Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III.
